title: Runtime-Model Compatibility Matrix and LTS-Aware Upgrade Gates
creator: Ayesha Kapoor
description: We need a robust way to represent and enforce compatibility between model artifacts and runtime versions across hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments. This ticket delivers a compatibility matrix service (compat-check) and LTS-aware rollout gates that the control plane and routing layer will consult before sending traffic. The goal is to prevent silent incompatibilities, enable safe rollouts of runtime upgrades, and provide clear operator tooling for pinning and migration.
acceptance_criteria: 1) compat-check service exposes an authoritative matrix mapping model-version + model-layout -> supported runtime versions (semver ranges) and required feature flags. 2) Routing layer queries compat-check before assignment; incompatible combinations are rejected and routed to fallback model/runtime per policy. 3) Rollout gates support progressive rollouts by LTS channel and percentage canaries; console shows per-channel status and automatic rollback trigger when error/latency thresholds breached. 4) Dedicated and Private deployment upgrade playbooks use the same matrix; operators can audit pinned mappings and generate migration plans. 5) Automated CI tests verify compatibility for all newly onboarded model versions and runtime releases and surface blockers in the release dashboard.
tasks: Design compat-check schema (CSV+JSON) and storage model (Postgres table + cache TTL).
Implement compat-check microservice with read API (/compat?model=...&model_version=...&runtime=...).
Integrate compat-check into routing control plane (pre-route validation hook).
Add UI in Console: compatibility matrix viewer, pin/unpin controls for model-runtime pairs, and LTS channel management page.
Implement rollout gate primitives: LTS channels config, percent-based canaries, automatic rollback triggers based on SLOs.
Create CI smoke tests: for each model build run runtime-compat test matrix against target runtime RCs and record results in release dashboard.
Document Dedicated/Private operator upgrade playbook that uses compat-check outputs and includes migration checklist.
Create migration script to update pinned mappings for customers during a scheduled runtime upgrade with a dry-run mode.
Add audit logging for pin/unpin and forced-fallback events to satisfy compliance and SRE postmortems.
comments: 2026-02-26 Michael Chen: Scoped initial API for compat-check; will return 200 + JSON {compatible: true|false, reason: str, recommended_fallback: {model, runtime}}. Need to keep response small for routing performance.
2026-02-28 PM review (Sofia Martinez): Console must allow product teams to define per-customer pinning and timeboxed overrides for emergency rollouts.
2026-03-01 Design feedback (Ravi Patel): Add visualization of compatibility churn over time so PMs can see when models require runtime features frequently.
2026-03-03 Engineering decision: store matrix as materialized view derived from model metadata (model-layout, ops requirements) and runtime capability tags. This avoids repeated manual edits.

2026-03-04 Ops note (Elena Garcia): Private deployments will not auto-upgrade; compat-check will be read-only for private control planes unless operator triggers migration script. We'll include a CLI helper.

2026-03-05 Michael Chen: Implemented basic compat-check prototype and added integration test to routing CI. Perf note: cache TTL 30s keeps extra 0.6ms p95 in pre-route. Adding benchmark to measure at scale.
notes: Key trade-offs: 1) Centralized compat service simplifies governance but is an extra control-plane dependency; mitigate via aggressive caching and fallback-to-policy logic. 2) Strict pinning reduces unexpected regressions but increases ops burden for customers—we will support policy types: strict, advisory, auto-migrate.
